scenarios.name: typical_noise_scenario
scenarios.description: Mixed: page header, page footer, blank lines, trailing whitespace.
scenarios.input:
Page 1 of 10

Real content starts here.



  
  Real content continues.


- 2 -
scenarios.expected_after_rule:
Real content starts here.

Real content continues.

scenarios.name: excessive_whitespace
scenarios.description: Lots of consecutive blank lines and trailing spaces — should collapse to single blank lines.
scenarios.input:
First paragraph.   





Second paragraph.   
   
Third paragraph.
scenarios.expected_after_rule:
First paragraph.

Second paragraph.

Third paragraph.

scenarios.name: page_header_footer
scenarios.description: Pure page header + footer + clean body — headers/footers must be stripped.
scenarios.input:
Document Title | Confidential   

This is the body of the document with the actual content.

- 5 -
scenarios.expected_after_rule: This is the body of the document with the actual content.

scenarios.name: format_markers
scenarios.description: HTML comment and Markdown image — both should be stripped.
scenarios.input:
Before image.

<!-- TODO: add caption later -->

![alt text](http://example.com/img.png)

After image.

scenarios.name: code_blocks_preserved
scenarios.description: Markdown code fences must keep their internal whitespace and newlines intact.
scenarios.input:
Intro line.

```python
def foo():
    if True:
        return 42
```

Outro line.
scenarios.expected_after_rule:
Intro line.

```python
def foo():
    if True:
        return 42
```

Outro line.

scenarios.name: markdown_structure_preserved
scenarios.description: Headings, lists, blockquotes, bold/italic should not be touched.
scenarios.input:
# Heading

- item 1
- item 2

> A quote.

**bold** and *italic*.
scenarios.expected_after_rule:
# Heading

- item 1
- item 2

> A quote.

**bold** and *italic*.

scenarios.name: clean_text_unchanged
scenarios.description: Already clean text — must not be over-cleaned.
scenarios.input:
This is perfectly clean text.

It has reasonable paragraphs and no noise.
scenarios.expected_after_rule:
This is perfectly clean text.

It has reasonable paragraphs and no noise.

scenarios.name: ocr_errors
scenarios.description: OCR noise: weird ligatures, ligature 'fi' as a single char, broken punctuation.
scenarios.input:
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

Thé quïck brøwn føx jumps øver the lazy døg.
scenarios.expected_after_rule:
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

Thé quïck brøwn føx jumps øver the lazy døg.
